tutorial.title: How DaiGo works
tutorial.s1_b: Pick a pickup and a drop. You see the price first, with no surprise charges.
tutorial.s2_h: Drivers on your way are told
tutorial.s2_b: Drivers who already go your way get the request and have 75 seconds to answer.
tutorial.s3_b: You can talk about the price inside a safe range. The range keeps it fair for both sides.
tutorial.decideFast: Decide fast, someone else might take the ride.
tutorial.s4_b: A pickup code makes sure you board the right car. You can share your live trip with family.
tutorial.shareLink: Anyone with your link can follow the trip until you stop sharing.
tutorial.s5_b: Pay online or in cash, then rate the ride. Good ratings build trust for everyone.
tutorial.cashHint: The driver confirms with a photo

terms.title: Terms and cost sharing
terms.notice: A short plain summary. This is a student project, not legal advice.
terms.what_b: DaiGo helps people who travel the same way share a ride. We connect riders with people already going that way.
terms.cost_b: The price shown is a contribution to the cost of the trip, kept under a cap. It is not a taxi fare. Always agree on the price before you start.
terms.safety_b: Check the pickup code, keep live sharing on, and use the emergency button if you feel unsafe. In danger, call 112.
terms.accounts_b: Use your real details. Repeated late cancellations or bad behaviour lead to warnings and, after five, a suspension you can appeal.
terms.privacy_b: We keep only what the service needs. Phone numbers stay hidden until you are close. Photos are private and shown only through short links.
terms.limits_b: DaiGo is a connection tool. Drivers and riders are responsible for their own conduct, licences and insurance.
